title: Splitting of Liftings in Product Spaces II
summary: Let $(X, \mfA,P)$ and $(Y, \mfB,Q)$ be two probability spaces, $R$ be their skew product on the product $σ$-algebra $\mfA\otimes\mfB$ and $\{(\mfA_y,S_y)\colon y\in{Y}\}$ be a $Q$-disintegration of $R$. Then let $\mfA\dd\mfB$ be the $σ$-algebra generated $\mfA\otimes\mfB$ and by the family $\mcM:=\{E\subset{X\times{Y}}\colon \exists\;N\in\mfB_0\;\forall\;y\notin{N}\;\wh{S_y}(E^y)=0\}$ and $\wh{R_{\dd}}$ be the extension of $R$ such that $\mcM$ becomes the family of $\wh{R_*}$-zero sets ($\wh{S_y}$ is the completion of $S_y$ and $\mfB_0=\{B\in\mfB: Q(B)=0\}$).
